<thought>To find the required template, I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog using the described bond changes and functional group transformations. This should return templates that match the intramolecular Michael addition cyclization of chalcones to flavanones. Once I have the list, I can select the appropriate template and provide its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1CC(c2ccccc2)Oc3c(ccc(O)c3)O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "aromatic_hydroxyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether_oxygen"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-8", "6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
